design_philosophy: Clean, modern, apple-esque. Emphasize trust, clarity, and ease of use. Focus on generous negative space, crisp typography, subtle soft shadows, and glassmorphism. Use green elements thoughtfully to signify action, health, and growth.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#1D1D1F]
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#1D1D1F]

typography.rules: Avoid generic bolding everywhere. Use varied font weights (e.g. font-medium, font-semibold). Apply 'tracking-tight' for headings larger than 32px. Line height must be tight for headers (leading-tight) and relaxed for body.

colors.rules: Never use pure black or pure white blindly. Always use Apple's soft greys (#1D1D1F for text, #FBFBFD for background). The primary CTA color is vibrant green (#34C759). Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text. Hover states on buttons must darken the green slightly.

surfaces_and_shadows.cards: bg-white rounded-2xl md:rounded-3xl border border-[#E5E5EA] shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]
surfaces_and_shadows.inputs: bg-[#F5F5F7] border border-transparent focus:bg-white focus:border-[#34C759] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#34C759]/20 rounded-xl transition-all duration-200
surfaces_and_shadows.rules: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or floating headers. Always use the glassmorphism utility classes.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped interfaces.
layout_and_spacing.comparison_table: Use CSS Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4) with horizontal scrolling on mobile. Hide complex details inside accordions on mobile.
layout_and_spacing.rules: Follow the 'Bento Grid' protocol for the provider detail modal and summary stats. Ensure everything is mobile-first.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or soft rectangle (rounded-xl). Apply hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-transform.
components.toggles: Apple-style pill toggles with a sliding white thumb inside a grey/green track for Health vs Life insurance.
components.badges: Small, rounded-full, subtle background (e.g., bg-[#E8F5E9] text-[#00A86B]) for 'Most Popular' or 'Best Coverage'.
components.table: Side-by-side columns with a sticky left column (features) and sticky header (provider logos/prices) on desktop.
components.rules: Customize Shadcn UI components heavily to remove the default rigid boxy 'Vercel' look and adapt it to rounded, soft Apple-style aesthetics.

icons_and_assets.style: Use stroke-width 1.5 or 2. Keep icons minimal and geometric.

animations.hover: Subtle scale up (scale-105) for cards and buttons. Smooth background color transitions.
animations.page_transitions: Fade in and slight upward slide for main elements on load.
animations.rules: Animations should feel natural, snappy, and light, exactly like an iOS interface. No bouncy or excessive spring animations.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., `data-testid='category-switch-health'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize optical alignment and generous spacing.
Implement the landing hero section with a large, beautiful category switch (Health / Life) and a glassmorphism floating quote input form over the hero image.
Create a realistic mock data array for 5-8 insurance providers.
Build the comparison table using a sticky header so users can scroll down through features while keeping provider names visible.
Implement a clean, Apple-esque side panel or modal for the 'Provider detail view', utilizing bento-style info cards.
Ensure the green color (#34C759) is used purposefully for actions (Compare, Get Quote) and trust icons (Checkmarks).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this by making creative, distinctive frontend layouts.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all'). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Use modern pill-shaped or soft rounded buttons with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
